about.en: Hemi is a modular network that treats Bitcoin and Ethereum as parts of one system, aimed at programmable Bitcoin and BTC DeFi; it was co-founded by Jeff Garzik and Max Sanchez. HEMI, with a 10,000,000,000 supply, is the network token, on Ethereum at 0xeb964a1a6fab73b8c72a0d15c7337fa4804f484d, on BNB Chain and on the Hemi chain.
